integrity: The Lyapunov identity and characteristic polynomial are checked by exact rational arithmetic. The asymptotic convergence and invariant-measure classification are proved analytically; numerical root values are used only to interpret the published finite-time tangent growth rates.
scientific_limitations: The convergence theorem applies to bounded forward solutions on the exact slice \(k_1=0,\ k_2=g>0,\ k_3=k_4=k_5=0\); it does not prove that all initial conditions are bounded and does not cover other parameter regimes. The novelty comparison cannot exclude an unindexed prior statement.
title: Exact Lyapunov monotonicity rules out bounded recurrent dynamics on the line-equilibrium slice of a 5D segmented disc dynamo
